content: Hi there! How can I help you today?
Okay! What role are you looking to fill? (e.g., mobile, QA, DevOps)
Okay, a frontend developer. What is the team size you’re looking for, or are you looking for a single developer?
Got it! A single frontend developer. What work model are you looking for? (remote, hybrid, on-site)
Okay, on-site. When would you like to start the project? (timeline)
Okay, 9 weeks. How long do you need the service for? (duration, e.g., 3 months)
Okay, 4 months. Full. Now, could you please provide your full name, email, company name, company location, and phone number (optional)?
Okay, Amitlevi, amitlevi@gmail.com, Mindeprde, Italy. Full. Let’s confirm – you’re looking for a single on-site frontend developer to start in 9 weeks for a duration of 4 months. Is that correct?
Got it! We’re capturing the details and will follow up.
